description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (1.70 each), grants [Attach Water], [Aquatic Strike] and [Rain Arrow Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Aquatic Strike
description.text: Grants [Magical High Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the back row after using a Water ability

description.name: Rain Arrow Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Rain Arrow after using a Water ability
